limitations: Only one Gmail account was accessible through the connected Gmail connector: subscriptions.2@faiblemedia.com. Any other company mailboxes are NOT covered and need their own connection.
Mailbox history begins 2025-12-08 (earliest message). Charges before that date cannot appear. Audit period: 2025-12-08 to 2026-10-26.

The connector returns message bodies and attachment metadata but provides no way to download PDF attachments or follow invoice links. Invoice PDFs were not opened; BytePlus invoice amounts exist only in PDFs/links and are unknown.
Gmail connector excludes Spam and certain suspicious/encrypted mail; trash was included in most searches. Anything auto-filtered to Spam would not be seen.
Broad vendor sweeps (q3, q5) were not paginated to the end (they are dominated by marketing mail). Billing-keyword searches (q1, q2, q4) were run to completion.

Charges paid through app stores, other cards/emails, vendor portals without email receipts, or invoices sent to a different address (e.g., Higgsfield, Kling, Google Workspace, earlier Sync invoices) cannot be seen.
No exchange-rate source was used. USD and INR totals are kept separate; no conversion applied.
Mastercard ending 3605 is the only payment-method identifier recorded (last four digits as shown in receipts).

'Welcome to Google Workspace' (Dec 9, 2025) and May-2026 emails saying 'premium features are included with your subscription'. No billing/invoice emails found (Workspace billing usually goes to the admin account). Could be a trial or a paid seat.
